n-binance-intelligence.title: Binance Intelligence coins
n-binance-intelligence.summary: Coins on Flap named for Binance Intelligence, the AI product line Binance presented at its 2026-10-05 12:00 UTC livestream. The @binancezh account promoted that livestream on 2026-10-04 ("Binance Intelligence launch livestream") and a Chinese-language launch AMA on 2026-10-06, and a 2026-10-06 post by @scottmelker says Binance Intelligence has three products: Agent OS, Binance AI and Binance AI Pro. The coins are not shown to be issued by or affiliated with Binance. 币安智能 (Binance Intelligence; pool created 2026-09-30, before the announcement), bibi (metadata invites readers to the Binance Intelligence launch livestream; pool created 2026-10-04) and 币安AI (metadata: "Binance will soon release new AI"; pool created 2026-10-05 at 14:39 UTC, after the livestream began) trade on the name. Measured: three coins across all their pools.

n-binance-intelligence.interpretation: Binance has named and launched an AI product line, and three Flap coins carry that name or point to the livestream. The coins are not shown to be issued by or affiliated with Binance, and 币安智能 (Binance Intelligence) lost about two thirds of its price over 24h at discovery. Product claims are Binance's own and are not verified here.
